profile.headline: Software Engineer | AI Strategy & Transformation | Enterprise Technology Leader | AI Products & Agentic AI | Enterprise Modernization | Data & AI | 15+ Years
profile.summary:
Technology & AI Transformation Leader | Enterprise AI Strategy | AI Product Innovation | Enterprise Modernization

I am a technology leader with 15+ years of experience designing, modernizing, and delivering enterprise software and leading cross-functional technology initiatives across the full product lifecycle.

My focus is increasingly at the intersection of AI strategy, enterprise transformation, technology architecture, product innovation, and business value realization.

I work at the point where business strategy meets technology execution—translating complex business challenges into scalable technology and AI solutions, aligning stakeholders, guiding engineering teams, and turning emerging technologies into practical enterprise capabilities.

My experience includes:
• Enterprise application modernization and technology transformation
• Architecture and API/platform strategy
• .NET, Angular, cloud-connected enterprise applications and data platforms
• AI/Gen AI, AI agents, RAG, Stardog RDF type knowledge graphs and AI-enabled workflows
• AI product strategy and technology innovation
• Cross-functional technical leadership and team development
• Production delivery, security, governance and operational excellence
• Legacy-to-modern platform transformation and enterprise integration

In my current technical leadership work, I have led modernization initiatives across legacy enterprise applications, developed reusable architecture/components to accelerate migration, mentored and enabled engineering teams, and helped move multiple applications through production delivery.

I am also actively expanding from technology execution into enterprise AI strategy and leadership, with a particular interest in:
AI Transformation | AI Strategy | AI Product Innovation | Enterprise AI Architecture | Agentic AI | Knowledge Graphs | AI Governance | AI Operating Models | Business Value & ROI

I am pursuing the MIT xPRO Executive Certificate in AI Strategy and Product Innovation to strengthen the strategic, product, organizational and leadership dimensions of my enterprise AI work.

My long-term objective is to help organizations determine where AI should be applied, how it should be governed, how it should be operationalized, and how AI investments can create measurable business outcomes.

Core strengths: Enterprise Technology | AI Transformation | Architecture | Product Innovation | Modernization | AI/Gen AI | Agentic AI | Data & Knowledge | Technical Leadership | Strategic Execution

positions.description:
Present client : UPS, GA
Full Stack developer |
Technology Leadership | Enterprise Modernization | AI Transformation 

Lead enterprise technology modernization and strategic initiatives across legacy application transformation, architecture, AI enablement and delivery. Partner with engineering, product, architecture and business stakeholders to translate organizational objectives into scalable technology solutions and measurable delivery outcomes.

• Led and mentored 7+ developers across architecture, modernization practices, development standards and production deployment. 
• Led 7 legacy applications through production deployment in less than one year, materially compressing the historical migration timeline.
• Lead exploration and development of AI initiatives including knowledge graphs, AI agents and AI-enabled enterprise workflows.
• Designed and implemented reusable core libraries and migration patterns to standardize and accelerate enterprise application transformation.

Previous Client: Genuine Parts Company, Atlanta, GA, 
Senior .NET Developer/.NET Architect
As a Lead developer at a client onsite who is dominating Auto parts distribution business where in I worked on Search portal which helps to connect 6k stores across US region with searching vehicle parts. Provided production support and product enhancements for legacy and new version application development.
